Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api

Interface FactStore<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The object/value type of the fact.
All Superinterfaces:
Map<String,FactReference<T>>
All Known Implementing Classes:
FactMap
public interface FactStore<T> extends Map<String,FactReference<T>>
FactStore is an extension of a Map. It's a Key/Value store where the key is a String representing the fact's name, and the value is a FactReference itself.
